intent: Release procedure: verify before you push; flake rerun policy (#70, #71)
notes: `procedures/release-and-deploy.md`: new "Verify before you push (the 2.24.0 lesson)" section. Before every push to `dev`, run every test file that references a changed file (search tests for the filename/symbols; docs and templates can be pinned by unrelated test files), run the same fast suite CI runs, and never edit files during a test run. Checklist step 1 points to it. Evidence: CI history 2026-09-15..2026-10-09 (53 runs, 10 reruns, 8 red); four real-bug commits were all pushed after partial local runs.

New "Flakes: rerun once, then record" section: rerun a one-platform failure in an unrelated test once, record it on its tracking issue, and treat a two-platform or repeat failure as real. Tracking issues filed: #70 (Windows `dashboard-ui` Playwright flakes, 9 failures in 8 tests) and #71 (`test_loop_suspension` `[paused]` JSONDecodeError on Windows). `TestPidWalker` is fixed (cc6acde) and no longer a known flake.
`inbox.md`: the flake note now points to #70 / #71 and the rerun policy.
